title: Plastic Honey Bottles
heading: Wholesale Plastic Honey Bottles & Jars
description: PET honey bottles and jars for upright squeeze dispensing, cap-down use, nozzle dispensing and wide-mouth filling. Gracepack supplies bear bottles, ribbed bottles, inverted bottles and plastic jars with matching closure options for wholesale orders and custom plastic packaging projects.
points: Choose PET dispensing bottles for serving through a cap, or wide-mouth jars for spoon access.
Select the capacity by target honey net weight and the headspace established in your filling trial.
Specify the matched cap, liner or seal and label requirements when requesting samples and wholesale pricing.

title: Glass Honey Jars
heading: Wholesale Glass Honey Jars
description: Glass honey jars in mini round, hexagonal and beehive-shaped formats for branded honey lines, commercial samples and hospitality portions. Gracepack supplies the selected jar with a matching metal lid, model-specific dimensions and protective export packing for wholesale orders.
points: Compare mini, hexagon and ribbed profiles by shelf footprint and usable label area.
Select a lid and liner for the exact jar finish, then validate the sealing assembly with your filling process.
Include glass dividers, carton quantities and pallet requirements when requesting a shipping quotation.

title: Honey Bear Bottles

points: Compare mini and standard-capacity bear formats by honey fill target, assembled height and grip.
Fit your label within the front panel so the molded face and bear details remain visible.
Choose the matched closure and dispensing opening; confirm cap color and packing quantities in your quote.

title: Honey Squeeze Bottles
heading: Wholesale Honey Squeeze Bottles
description: PET honey squeeze bottles in upright ribbed, bear, pointed-nozzle and inverted cap-down formats for branded honey lines and wholesale orders. Gracepack supplies each selected bottle with a compatible dispensing cap and samples for fill, flow, label and line-handling checks.
points: Choose an upright or cap-down bottle to suit your shelf presentation and serving method.
Evaluate the outlet, squeeze response and any proposed valve using your honey at its intended serving conditions.
Approve cap fit, reclosure and filled-pack leakage checks for the selected bottle and closure.

Approve the assembled jar and lid with the carton dividers and protective packing used for shipment.
